3240-6277-6462-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
3240-6277-6462-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

730-1479-2443-2841.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
730-1479-2443-2841.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2131-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
2131-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4247-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

240-3480-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2020-4477.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-4477.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-4477.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

104-549-2685-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-549-2685-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3151-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-7297.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

924-1753-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-1753-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-1753-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-1753-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2440-6791-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

6248-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6248-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

792-4050-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4460-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

643-1636-7280.notablePrerequisites:
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-7280.description:
Animate Maskwood using Donatello.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1491-2113-3129-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3096-3755-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

654-880-7201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3110-3941-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: "Manifold Key" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
3110-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute.
Repeat.

232-1235-4823-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Timeless Witness.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Timeless Witness with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Timeless Witness tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2820-4679-6968.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

6188-6633-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
6188-6633-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

4802-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

343-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
343-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites:
You are the monarch.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
343-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

141-1562-5440.description:
Cast Abuelo's Awakening by paying {3}{W}, targeting Machine God's Effigy.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Abuelo's Awakening, targeting Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the copy of Abuelo's Awakening, returning Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Naru Meha that's still an artifact.
Put Machine God's Effigy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Machine God's Effigy's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, copying Abuelo's Awakening, targeting Machine God's Effigy.
Repeat from step 4.

1296-1810-2743.description:
Cast Finale of Promise by paying {10}{R}{R}, causing you to cast Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard without paying its mana cost and copying it twice, with all spells targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1170-2032-2369-5116-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled with Isochron Scepter that does not remove a permanent and/or counter a spell, and that has legal targets, if needed.
Kiora has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1170-2032-2369-5116-5261.description:
Activate Kiora's loyalty ability twice by removing two loyalty counters from it, untapping Gilded Lotus and Isochron Scepter.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Kiora.
Resolve the copy of the instant card.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent using Kiora.

3809-4231-5041-5184.description:
Activate Deadeye Plunderers by paying {2}{U}{B}, creating two Treasure, one Food and one Clue artifact token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3440-4050-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {1}.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1030-1379-1651-2034-4840.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1379-1651-2034-4840.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myr tokens, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

512-2872-4050.notablePrerequisites: Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-4050.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Clever Conjurer, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

176-3000-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-3000-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

1183-1766-4853.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-1766-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion
